lines: Southeast Asia, some country.
That night, I was once again cornered by a worthless mission.
Horse‑headed demon
Kuahaha! The game of tag is over, Taimanin brat! You can't escape our pursuit!
Me
Heh, not bad, horse bastard. You look like you eat carrots every day, but you actually have some sense.
Horse‑headed demon
I'm honored by your praise. Unfortunately, I have a far superior brain compared to humans. Now, kneel!!!
Bang!!!!
Me
Guh—
At the same time as the gunshot, a small puff of dust swirled at my feet.
I grimaced and, as ordered, dropped to my knees on the ground.
In front of me, a nauseating number of gun muzzles were lined up.
They were the horse‑headed demons that ruled this town, and their subordinates.
If I made a wrong move, my ass would surely end up like Swiss cheese.
Me
(Good grief, as always, another reckless mission, Asagi‑sensei—)
I let out a slight sigh while kneeling on the ground.
This time, under Asagi‑sensei's orders, I had come to this Southeast Asian underworld.
The demon gang that controls this town has colluded with nearby warlord groups, engaging in illegal activities like arms trafficking.
My mission was to infiltrate their hideout and obtain proof of their collusion.
And the mission itself had been progressing smoothly as planned—
Me
(At the very end, I end up in this jam, huh?)
Me
(The demons that dominate the dark city, and the warlord organization they teamed up with—their enhanced soldier unit.)
Demons
Guhaha. Humans think they can be taken lightly. Now then, how shall we fuck this kid?
Enhanced soldier unit
Orcs, demons, and other denizens of the darkness.
And soldiers clad in the cutting‑edge exoskeletons called Fist of Steel 2.
Behind them stood a massive, squat, multi‑legged tank.
Multi‑legged tank
The guys who sensed that the secret data had been stolen from the hideout even sent a huge beast like this just to capture me alone.
It's called the FSD Clayos.
It's a multi‑legged tank‑type drone made by Freedom of Africa, a South African arms company.
A cutting‑edge drone weapon with overwhelming firepower and thick armor that could subdue an entire small city by itself.
If they can bring out a monster‑like weapon like this, there's no way we have any chance.
We're completely out of options, forced to wait meekly to be minced.
Well, that’s the case ‘under normal circumstances’.
Horse‑headed demon
Well then, shall we hear your pleas for mercy? If you tell us whose pawn you are, we’ll kill you without any suffering—
Horse‑headed demon
No, what's so funny about you?
The horse‑headed demon pointing its barrel at my forehead asked suspiciously.
It was because I, cornered in a dead‑end with no escape, grinned defiantly in the face of certain death.
Me
What’s funny? Everything’s going exactly according to my plan! Now, go, Yukikaze! Revy!
Revy
YEAHHHH!!! Finally it’s dance time, huh, ninja boy! I've been waiting!
Mizuki Yukikaze
Ugh! How long are you going to keep us waiting, you stupid Fuuma! I was starting to worry!
Dooooooon!!!
Horse‑headed demon
The ground shook with the roar.
Cracks spread across the decayed, ancient pavement, and it began to collapse.
Caught in it, the demons, reinforced soldiers, and the drone tank surrounding me were immobilized.
A massive cloud of dust rose, and two shadows leapt from a ruined building by the road, blending into the haze.
Revy
Wahaha! Is this some new hero movie or what? This is why ninjas are so entertaining!
Yukikaze
Cough cough. The fireworks are fine, but tone down the amount of bombs a bit. You almost buried me under the rubble!
Me
Haha. My bad, Yukikaze. I’ll be more careful next time.
Yukikaze
Hmph. Even if you say that, you'll just start something even more reckless next time—
Yukikaze
Anyway, enough of that, the match starts now, Revy!
Yukikaze
You and I, we'll finally settle once and for all who's the better gunwoman!
Revy
Heh, fine, I'll play along, you ninja‑girl brat!
Revy
Can you keep up with this Taimanin Revy's gunplay? YEAHHHH!!!
Da‑da‑da‑da!!!
Demons
Hiiiii!!! What the hell are these women!!!
The two women in their Taimanin suits took down demon after demon and reinforced soldiers one after another.
As far as I know, these two are the best gunfighters in the world.
The lightning‑fast Taimanin, Mizuki Yukikaze.
Revy, the gunwoman of Lagoon Trading who runs a courier service in the lawless city of Roanapla.
I had asked the two of them to lie in wait so I could complete this mission.
Me
Come on, Revy, go wild however you want!!
Me
But don't kill that leader guy! He's an important witness!
Yes, the whole plan was aimed at that.
By deliberately getting noticed after infiltrating their hideout, I drew out the gang's senior members,
and together with Yukikaze and Revy waiting with the bombs we set on the ruined streets, we would take them all in one sweep.
Revy
OK, got it, Fuuma! That means we can do whatever we want to everyone except that bastard, right!?
Revy
Come on, you junk metal! Fly up to the moon in pleasure!
Enhanced soldiers
Boom, boom—flashy explosions rang out in succession.
The heavily armored exoskeleton troops were blown apart by Revy's bullets,
and the grenades she tossed, one after another.
It seemed like they were fighting recklessly, following instinct, but that wasn't the case.
Revy ran through enemy lines, precisely targeting the seams and joints of the soldiers' armor and shooting through them.
Also, she detonates grenades after confirming sufficient destructive effect.
Truly battle‑hardened. A calculated, breathtakingly fierce fighting style.
Revy
Come on, brace yourself, you ninja‑girl brat!!
Revy
Those pig bastards over there and the robot guy are 1 point each, and that huge tank is 10 points!
Yukikaze
Hmph! I won't lose either, and don't call me a brat!
While trading light‑hearted banter, Yukikaze and Revy steadily rack up the score.
Revy's beloved twin pistols, Sword Katars, mercilessly turn the oncoming demons into a blood‑soaked feast,
while Yukikaze's lightning gun, the Lightning Shooter, pierces the massive drone tank with a single shot, silencing it.
As fellow pistol users, perhaps they share something in common.
Though they argue verbally, their breathing on the battlefield matches perfectly.
Me
(But if someone this awesome showed up to help every time, I'd have it easy... Well, there's no such sweet deal.)
I support the two with kunai and ninja blades, thinking that as I grin wryly.
Despite being unable to use ninjutsu, Revy still displays combat power that rivals even Taimanin.
I met her when we were on a mission in Southeast Asia not long ago.
Though that mission had its complications, we eventually clicked—
And now, again, we're cooperating specially on a mission in some Southeast Asian country.
By the way, the Taimanin suit Revy is wearing now is the one she used on the previous mission.
According to Revy—
Revy
Ah, this? When I first saw it I thought, what the hell, this looks like a crazy prostitute's outfit.
Revy
But once I tried it on it was easy to move. It's fun, so I brought it again this time.
She seemed surprisingly fond of it.
Horse‑headed demon
Guh!? Don't get cocky, humans!? Our forces are still far superior!! Kill them! Kill them!!!
Multi‑legged tank
Enhanced soldier unit
A rampaging horse-headed demon gave the order.
In response, drone tanks and fully armed elite soldiers surrounded us.
The ambush was effective, but they still had forces left.
Revy
Alright, kids, this is where it starts. We’ll capture that horse‑headed leader and get the hell out of this shitty town.
Revy
This is a massive job.
Me
Yeah. Sorry for dragging you into this reckless plan, Revy.
Revy gave a wicked grin at my words.
Revy
Heh, it’s fine. Jobs this fun don’t come around often.
Revy
In this crappy world, having fun is important—our boss always says that.
Revy
Let’s go, Yukikaze, Fuuma! Follow my ass!
Me & Yukikaze
Got it!!
Gunfire and explosions ripped through the tropical street scented with rot and blood.
We followed the unstoppable gunman and dove straight into the fierce battle.
